extracted.name: Grandma’s Secret Pie Crust
extracted.description: The secret’s out! A great basic pie crust from Grandma’s secret recipes. Vinegar is the key to this dough that rolls out perfectly, and the bakes beautifully.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
In large bowl mix flour and salt. Cut in shortening with two butter knives.
In a separate bowl, mix together egg, vinegar, and water. Drizzle wet mixture into dry mixture, cutting it in.
Roll out dough, and fit into two 9-inch pie pans.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
